newsitem.title: USA: Pages names chief financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Pages names chief financial officer.

text.p: Pages Inc said Tuesday it named Steven Canan as chief financial officer and treasurer effective immediately.

The company said Canan will assume responsibilities currently handled by Randall Asmo, who is interim CFO. Asmo, a vice president of the company, will asssume functions relating to financial planning, acquisitions and public relations, it said.
Canan has served in various financial-related positions in Pages for the past eight years.
Pages publishes leisure- and curriculum-related books.
